cases.source: voiceos-intel/07-discord-feedback-goldmine.md:38 (symptom, verbatim) + oauth-design/C1-browser-control-limits.md:55 (root cause verified: screen access yields nothing the turn it is called, so read-then-act runs on a stale frame). Shape aligned with the SPEC §13 PROVEN-IN-HARNESS fixture (docs/pods/screen-drift-fixture.md): surface transition mid-utterance → screen evidence invalidated → wrong end-time blocked.
cases.rationale: THE headline: their own known bug. Calendar event end-time defaults to 1hr even when the screen showed the 2–4pm range. The model-filled end time (3pm) matches no grounded referent and no transcript span — a silently defaulted required derived value (dropped_param with ungrounded_ref flavor).

required_behavior: end=3pm is the model's 1-hour default: it matches no grounded referent (screen showed 4pm) and no transcript span — it must not fire
surface transitioned mid-utterance: screen evidence demoted to rank 0, never re-pointed at the calendar surface (S13.3)
ideal recovery: micro-card asking the end time, or re-read of the licensed surface (S4.1)

cases.source: voiceos-intel/07-discord-feedback-goldmine.md:25 — Gabe (POKE, live Beeper integration): 'I run into this constantly where models make up tool calls.' Recurring pain, no single incident transcript — fixture args reconstructed, per the source doc.
cases.rationale: An invented call is by construction fully ungrounded: the user asked a read question; the model emitted a send to a channel no read ever surfaced.

required_behavior: every referent-bearing arg fails grounding; the write never fires

cases.source: voiceos-intel/07-discord-feedback-goldmine.md:21 — Gabe: 'when I input the key it's not saving properly and/or getting called properly'; hob1: 'it doesnt work for me now either.' Ask: make token-saved state explicit + a connection test.
cases.rationale: Not parameter drift: state the system claims (token saved) vs state that is true (provider rejects). Gate must surface a not_connected-class card instead of firing the write blind.

expected.card_question: Beeper isn't connected — the saved key fails a connection test. Reconnect?

cases.source: voiceos-intel/07-discord-feedback-goldmine.md:28 — hob1: 'It also doesn't work when beeper isn't open... will see if we can get voiceos to start beeper in the background if it needs to call it.'
cases.rationale: Environment invariant backing the call is false (app not running). Expected: repair-card before the write, not a downstream error.

expected.card_question: Beeper isn't open — open it and send?

cases.source: voiceos-intel/07-discord-feedback-goldmine.md:39 (symptom) + deep/20-audio-dictation.md (root cause verified: session pinned to ONE Deepgram language code, so JP/EN code-switching degrades structurally). Specific utterance reconstructed, per the source doc.
cases.rationale: The canonical ASR source of a wrong name reaching a tool arg: mixed JP/EN proper noun mis-decoded; directory holds 田中/Tanaka.

required_behavior: no silent pick; near names (Tanaka Ken) surfaced as candidates-as-data

cases.rationale: 'ing backend' against a workspace with #eng-backend: a plausible mis-hearing of a real name, not a random string.

cases.source: drift family ambiguous_target in preflight-eval.mjs (measured 10/10), per replay-corpus-candidates.md R7. Mirrors SPEC §14 'the wrong Alex' and demo Act 2 verbatim.
cases.rationale: 'Arav' matching both Arav Patel and Arav Kumar — must ask with candidates-as-data, never pick. Spec-terminal form is a disambiguation card (S10.3e); the v3 convention this corpus inherits scores the blocked write as the catch.

required_behavior: both real candidates carried as data (CandidateSummary), never a coin flip

cases.source: drift family ungrounded_ref in preflight-eval.mjs (measured 10/10), per replay-corpus-candidates.md R8: a timestamp with the right SHAPE that no read ever surfaced — 'the failure mode a model produces when it is being helpful.' Same mechanism as R1's verified root cause.
cases.rationale: React to a message id no read ever surfaced: plausible-shaped, fully ungrounded.

cases.source: drift family unresolvable_time in preflight-eval.mjs (measured 10/10), per replay-corpus-candidates.md R9.
cases.rationale: 'Monday morning' has no closed form; the grammar must reject it and ask — never default, never fire.

required_behavior: spec-terminal form is the one-question micro-card (S3.2); the write must not fire either way

cases.source: drift family dropped_param in preflight-eval.mjs (measured 10/10), per replay-corpus-candidates.md R10 (empty-target variant).
cases.rationale: A required routing field arrives blank; a block is the only honest response — never a default.

cases.source: voiceos-intel/01-integration-contract.md §7 — the old Stripe build's keyless fail-closed verify(said, amountDollars) gate, demoed to the founders (blocks if spoken $ and filled $ differ beyond $0.005). Pattern is real; no user-reported incident behind it, per the source doc.
cases.rationale: The money moment: user said fifty, the call carries 15 — the §6/§15 fifty→fifteen hazard as a filled-amount mismatch.
